variant:companion.name: observe
variant:companion.description: Look around: position, health, food, time, inventory, nearby players and mobs, current action.

variant:companion.name: reply
variant:companion.description: Answer whoever triggered this turn, the way they talked to you (whisper or public chat).

text.description: what to say; keep it short, it is Minecraft chat

variant:companion.name: say
variant:companion.description: Say something in public chat.

text.description: what to say; keep it short, it is Minecraft chat

variant:companion.name: whisper
variant:companion.description: Whisper a private message to one player.

text.description: what to say; keep it short, it is Minecraft chat

variant:companion.name: recent_chat
variant:companion.description: Recent chat lines and events (oldest first).

variant:companion.name: remember
variant:companion.description: Save a long-term note (facts about players, places, promises). Survives restarts.

about.description: player or topic the note is about

variant:companion.name: recall
variant:companion.description: Search long-term notes. Without a query returns the latest ones.

variant:companion.name: pos
variant:companion.description: Report the bot's position.

variant:companion.name: hp
variant:companion.description: Report health, food and what the bot is doing.

variant:companion.name: stop
variant:companion.description: Stop whatever the bot is doing. Also the PvP kill switch: ends every fight with a player and every hunt, and an attacking PvP mode (revenge, targets, all) goes off.

variant:companion.name: config_list
variant:companion.description: List the settings that can be changed in game (feature toggles) with their current values.

variant:companion.name: config_get
variant:companion.description: Show one setting, what it does and whether it was changed in game.

variant:companion.name: config_set
variant:companion.description: Change a setting live (owners only), e.g. config_set llm.listen all, config_set reflexes.retreatBelow 6. Persists until config_reset.

variant:companion.name: config_reset
variant:companion.description: Undo in-game setting changes: one key, or all of them, back to the profile values (owners only).

variant:companion.name: come
variant:companion.description: Walk to a player (default: whoever asked).

player.description: player name; defaults to the requesting player

variant:companion.name: follow
variant:companion.description: Follow a player, staying close, until stopped. (Long-running: starts in the background and keeps going until stopped or replaced.)

player.description: player name; defaults to the requesting player

distance.description: how close to stay, in blocks

variant:companion.name: goto
variant:companion.description: Walk to block coordinates, any distance (long trips go in legs and can take minutes; it keeps going in the background until it arrives, gets stuck or is stopped). Omit y to go to the surface at x/z. (Long-running: starts in the background and keeps going until stopped or replaced.)

variant:companion.name: goto_player
variant:companion.description: Walk to where a player currently is (one-off, does not keep following).

variant:companion.name: look_at
variant:companion.description: Turn to look at a player.

variant:companion.name: jump
variant:companion.description: Jump once.

variant:companion.name: attack
variant:companion.description: Fight the most dangerous hostile mob nearby, or a specific entity by id. Never attacks players, villagers, golems, pets or named mobs.

entityId.description: entity id; default the most dangerous hostile mob nearby

radius.description: how far to look for a target, in blocks

variant:companion.name: guard
variant:companion.description: Stay near a player and kill hostile mobs that come close to them, until stopped. (Long-running: starts in the background and keeps going until stopped or replaced.)

player.description: player to protect; defaults to the requesting player

variant:companion.name: hunt
variant:companion.description: Hunt passive animals (cow, pig, sheep, chicken, rabbit, mooshroom) for food and pick up the drops. Never touches pets, named, tamed or leashed animals, babies, villagers or players, and by default leaves fenced animals alone.

animal.description: which animal; default the nearest huntable one

count.description: how many to kill

radius.description: how far to look, in blocks

pens.description: also hunt animals inside fences (only your own farm)

keepAtLeast.description: leave at least this many adults of each kind alive (sustainable herd)

reach.description: when an animal is out of reach on foot, bridge, pillar (up to 16 blocks of dirt, cobblestone or planks) or dig to it, never in protected areas or danger zones

variant:companion.name: gear_up
variant:companion.description: Put on the best armour in the inventory and put a totem of undying or a shield in the offhand.

danger.description: a fall or fire that could kill: the totem goes in the offhand whatever the health

variant:companion.name: pvp
variant:companion.description: PvP mode (owners only; anyone may turn it off or lower it): off (never fight players; also ends every fight and hunt) | defend (only fight back) | revenge (also go after whoever killed or attacked us) | targets (attack players on the target list) | all (attack every player in range except owners and friends). No mode: show the mode, targets and grudges.

variant:companion.name: attack_player
variant:companion.description: Put a player on the PvP target list (owners only): attacked on sight from now on (switches PvP to targets mode if needed). Never owners or friends.

variant:companion.name: spare_player
variant:companion.description: Take a player off the PvP target list and forgive any grudge against them, ending a fight or hunt with them.

variant:companion.name: hunt_player
variant:companion.description: Hunt a player down (owners only): put them on the target list, go where they were last seen and fight them. Gives up after combat.huntMinutes; "stop" or "pvp off" ends it. (Long-running: starts in the background and keeps going until stopped or replaced.)

variant:companion.name: pvp_list
variant:companion.description: Show the PvP mode, the target list, grudges (revenge: who, why, minutes left) and hunts.

variant:companion.name: eat
variant:companion.description: Eat the best food in the inventory, or the named item (e.g. rotten_flesh as a last resort when starving).

item.description: eat this item instead of the best food (rotten_flesh, spider_eye and the like only this way)

variant:companion.name: sleep
variant:companion.description: Sleep in a bed within 16 blocks (only works at night or during storms).

variant:companion.name: wake
variant:companion.description: Get out of bed.

variant:companion.name: pillar
variant:companion.description: Emergency escape: jump and place blocks underneath to stand on a pillar out of reach of mobs. Uses dirt/cobblestone/planks from the inventory.

item.description: block to use; default the most plentiful dirt/cobblestone/planks

variant:companion.name: climb_out
variant:companion.description: Get out of a pit, shaft or cave straight up to open sky: dig the block above if needed, jump and place a block underneath, repeat. Without blocks it carves stair steps up into the wall instead.

maxBlocks.description: give up after rising this many blocks

variant:companion.name: bunker
variant:companion.description: Hide from phantoms and other mobs: dig straight down 3 blocks, seal the hole above with a dug block, wait until morning (or until no hostiles are near), then climb out. Needs digging; not in protected areas. (Long-running: starts in the background and keeps going until stopped or replaced.)

maxMinutes.description: give up waiting after this long

untilDay.description: stay until morning instead of until mobs leave

variant:companion.name: inventory
variant:companion.description: List what the bot is carrying.

variant:companion.name: drop
variant:companion.description: Throw items towards the requesting player (or on the ground). item="all" drops everything.

item.description: item name, or "all"

count.description: how many; default the whole stack(s)

variant:companion.name: equip
variant:companion.description: Hold an item in the main hand.

variant:companion.name: collect
variant:companion.description: Mine a number of blocks of one type nearby and pick up the drops, with the right tool (crafts a pickaxe first for stone and ores when it can). Skips protected areas (spawn): if everything nearby is protected it walks out of the zone first. Needs digging enabled.

block.description: block name, e.g. oak_log, dirt, stone, cobblestone

variant:companion.name: recall_events
variant:companion.description: What happened: recent journal events (deaths, damage, kills, items, chat, actions, players, places...). Filter by type, time, place, player or text.

type.description: event types, comma separated: death, respawn, damage, kill, item_gained, item_lost, block_broken, block_placed, chat_in, chat_out, whisper, action, goal, player_seen, player_joined, player_left, place_visited, advancement, protected_area, food_spot, farm_started, found, connect, disconnect, llm_turn, container_changed, container_gone, help, site; or deaths, chat, items, blocks, players, actions, places, combat, llm, connections, food, finds, stuck, sites, chests, containers, storage

since.description: how far back: 30m, 1h, 2d, today, yesterday, a date (YYYY-MM-DD); default 24h

near.description: only events near "x y z" or "x z", optionally with a radius as 4th number (default 32)

text.description: only events whose details contain this text

fleet.description: include the other bots on this server

variant:companion.name: last_death
variant:companion.description: Where and when the bot last died, what killed it, what it lost, and whether the drops may still be there.

variant:companion.name: history
variant:companion.description: Summary of a period from the journal rollups: online time, deaths, actions and failures, items, places, players. Period: today, yesterday, a date, 3h, or an hour range like 10-12.

variant:companion.name: goto_death
variant:companion.description: Walk back to where the bot last died to pick up its dropped items (they despawn 5 minutes after death). (Long-running: starts in the background and keeps going until stopped or replaced.)

variant:companion.name: protect
variant:companion.description: Stay with a player as a bodyguard until stopped: keep close (between them and the nearest danger), kill mobs that threaten them (creepers near them first, archers with a shot at them, diving phantoms, mobs coming for them or that hurt them), block arrows with a shield, and toss them food when they look hurt. Never attacks players, pets, villagers, golems or named mobs; neutral mobs only when they attack. (Long-running: starts in the background and keeps going until stopped or replaced.)

player.description: player to protect; defaults to the requesting player

feed.description: toss food when their health is low (needs the server to send player health)

keepFood.description: food items to keep for itself

intercept.description: meet a mob walking at the player 6-12 blocks out on its path instead of at the player

pullAggro.description: with two or more mobs on the player, hit each once and step off so they follow the bot

variant:companion.name: feed_player
variant:companion.description: Walk up to a player and toss them food from the inventory (the best food, 1-2 items), keeping some for itself.

player.description: who to feed; defaults to the requesting player

keepFood.description: food items to keep for itself

variant:companion.name: wander
variant:companion.description: Take a short walk to a random spot within a radius of home (or of a given center, or of where the bot stands).

radius.description: how far from the center to wander, in blocks

x.description: center x; default home, else current position

variant:companion.name: set_home
variant:companion.description: Remember a home position (default: where the bot stands now).

variant:companion.name: go_home
variant:companion.description: Walk back to the remembered home position.

range.description: how close to get, in blocks

variant:companion.name: remember_place
variant:companion.description: Remember a named place (default: where the bot stands now), to walk back to later with goto_place.

variant:companion.name: forget_place
variant:companion.description: Forget a named place.

variant:companion.name: places
variant:companion.description: List home and remembered places.

variant:companion.name: goto_place
variant:companion.description: Walk to a place remembered with remember_place.

variant:companion.name: flee
variant:companion.description: Run away from the nearest hostile mob until it is a safe distance away.

distance.description: how far to get from the mob

entityId.description: run from this mob instead of the nearest hostile one

variant:companion.name: prepare_trip
variant:companion.description: Get ready to leave home: take food from my pantry and own chests up to trips.food items, hold my best weapon, and check health. Fails with what is missing (no weapon, too little food, low health) when I should not go; a food trip while starving goes anyway.

purpose.description: what the trip is for, for the report

kind.description: food trips may go while starving; the others need the kit

distance.description: planned distance from home, in blocks

waive.description: checks to skip for this trip

variant:companion.name: craft
variant:companion.description: Craft an item from what is in the inventory. Uses a crafting table within 16 blocks when the recipe needs one, or puts one down (from the inventory, or made from planks).

item.description: item to make, e.g. stick, crafting_table, stone_pickaxe

count.description: how many items to end up with (not recipe runs)

variant:companion.name: smelt
variant:companion.description: Smelt items in a furnace within 32 blocks (or one placed from the inventory), add fuel, wait and take the results.

item.description: item to smelt, e.g. raw_iron, sand, oak_log

fuel.description: fuel item; default the best one in the inventory (coal, charcoal, planks, logs...)

variant:companion.name: deposit
variant:companion.description: Put items into the nearest chest/barrel (or the one at x y z). item="all" stores everything except tools, armour, food and anything in keep; `items` stores exactly those counts. Without x y z it never picks the pantry (settings.storage.chests role pantry) for anything but food.

item.description: item name, or "all"

count.description: how many; default all of them

items.description: exact items and counts to store, e.g. {"snowball": 16}; overrides item and count

x.description: container x; omit all three to use the nearest chest/barrel

variant:companion.name: withdraw
variant:companion.description: Take items out of the nearest chest/barrel (or the one at x y z).

item.description: item name, or "all" to empty the container

count.description: how many; default all of that item

x.description: container x; omit all three to use the nearest chest/barrel

variant:companion.name: list_container
variant:companion.description: Say what is inside the nearest chest/barrel (or the one at x y z). Looks inside if it is within reach and the bot is idle, otherwise reports what it saw last time.

x.description: container x; omit all three to use the nearest chest/barrel

variant:companion.name: check_chests
variant:companion.description: Look inside its own chests (ones it placed) and the configured ones (settings.storage.chests) near home that it has not looked into lately, so what it remembers is right again: notes items taken or added, chests moved or broken, and says when the pantry runs low. Never opens anyone else's chest.

radius.description: chests within this many blocks of home

max.description: chests to look into this time

all.description: also chests it looked into lately

x.description: look into just this one of its chests (with y and z)

variant:companion.name: where_stored
variant:companion.description: Say where an item is stored, from what the bot remembers seeing in chests and barrels: position and how long ago it looked ("12 iron_ingot in the chest at 559 69 -47, seen 2 h ago"). Older sightings are marked as maybe changed. bring_item fetches it from its own chests.

item.description: item name or a word of it, e.g. iron, bread, oak_log

variant:companion.name: place_chest
variant:companion.description: Put down a new chest of its own near home (crafted from 8 planks when it has none): a free spot outside within `range` blocks of home, off paths and farmland, not beside a door, another chest, the farm, or in a protected area; inside (the owner's room) only when nothing outside works. Remembers it as its own storage chest.

range.description: how far from home to look for a spot

variant:companion.name: harvest
variant:companion.description: Harvest ripe wheat, carrots, potatoes and beetroot nearby (or within a radius of x y z, e.g. one field), pick up the drops and replant from the inventory.

radius.description: how far to look for crops, in blocks

x.description: centre of the field (with y and z); default where the bot stands

variant:companion.name: plant
variant:companion.description: Plant seeds (wheat_seeds, carrot, potato, beetroot_seeds) on empty farmland nearby.

seed.description: seed item; default whatever seeds the bot has

count.description: how many to plant at most

x.description: centre of the field (with y and z); default where the bot stands

variant:companion.name: till
variant:companion.description: Turn dirt or grass into farmland with a hoe, either at x y z or the nearest spots next to water. Needs digging enabled.

x.description: block to till; omit x/y/z to pick dirt near water

variant:companion.name: find_food
variant:companion.description: Scout for food beyond what is in sight: first known food spots, then an expanding spiral around home (or here) out to `radius` blocks, by day, avoiding water, lava and protected areas, until it sees huntable animals or a village farm. Remembers what it finds as places (food:animals, food:village_farm, food:water). Does not hunt; use hunt or keep_fed after. (Long-running: starts in the background and keeps going until stopped or replaced.)

radius.description: how far from home to scout, in blocks

crops.description: village farms (crops with villagers nearby) count as food too

keepAtLeast.description: only count animals above this many adults of a kind (a herd to spare)

from.description: centre of the search: home (when set) or where the bot stands

minRadius.description: skip rings at or inside this radius (an earlier, smaller search covered them)

seeds.description: pick up this many seeds on the way by breaking grass next to the path (for a farm later)

variant:companion.name: start_farm
variant:companion.description: Start a small farm of its own: picks grass or dirt by water near home (or a place), outside protected areas and away from anybody's builds or fields (or pours water from a bucket), then gets seeds by breaking grass (or uses carrots, potatoes, beetroot seeds), makes a hoe if needed, tills a plot around the water, plants it, fences and lights it if it has the materials, and remembers it as farm:1, farm:2... for farm_loop/farm_setup. Needs digging enabled. (Long-running: starts in the background and keeps going until stopped or replaced.)

place.description: remembered place (or home) to farm near; default home, else here

x.description: farm near this x (with z) instead

size.description: plot side, odd, around one water block (9 = 80 farmland)

radius.description: how far from the centre to look for water

seeds.description: seeds to collect before planting (breaks grass until it has them or gives up)

fence.description: fence the plot when it has (or can craft) enough fences

light.description: put torches on the corners when it has torches or coal

spawnClearance.description: never farm within this distance of the world spawn

variant:companion.name: tend_farm
variant:companion.description: Look after its own farm (farm:1, farm:2...): put the water back if it is gone (with a bucket), plant bare farmland, till trampled dirt again and plant it, and grow the plot a ring at a time towards `size` around its water with the seeds it has, keeping `seedReserve` seeds for replanting; short of seeds it takes them from its own and configured chests near home first. Use harvest for ripe crops. Needs digging enabled for tilling. (Long-running: starts in the background and keeps going until stopped or replaced.)

size.description: side of the square to grow the farm towards (one water block keeps 9x9 wet)

seedReserve.description: seeds kept for replanting: new cells only from seeds beyond these

maxCells.description: cells to plant or till at most this run

fromChests.description: short of seeds: take them from its own and configured chests near home first

spawnClearance.description: never till within this distance of the world spawn

variant:companion.name: gather_seeds
variant:companion.description: Get seeds for a farm by breaking surface grass and ferns nearby (open to the sky and near its own height, never cave grass; wheat seeds drop about 1 in 8) and picking them up. Keeps going, patch by patch out to the radius, until it has the seeds, the time is up or the grass runs out. Skips protected areas and the world spawn. First takes wheat seeds from its own and configured chests near home (fromChests). Needs digging enabled for the grass. (Long-running: starts in the background and keeps going until stopped or replaced.)

count.description: seeds to get

fromChests.description: take seeds from its own and configured chests near home before breaking grass

radius.description: how far to look for grass

spawnClearance.description: never break grass this close to the world spawn

variant:companion.name: forage
variant:companion.description: Stopgap food from what grows wild nearby: pick ripe sweet berries (the bush stays), cut kelp at the shore without diving (smelt it into dried kelp later), and with apples=true break oak and dark oak leaves for apples (about 1 in 200) and pick up apples lying around. Never on protected land. (Long-running: starts in the background and keeps going until stopped or replaced.)

radius.description: how far to look

max.description: bushes or kelp stalks to take at most

apples.description: also break leaves for apples (slow, low odds: a last resort)

leaves.description: leaves to break at most for apples

variant:companion.name: breed
variant:companion.description: Breed two adult animals of a kind it sees (cows/sheep with wheat, pigs with carrots/potatoes/beetroot, chickens with seeds), leading them towards its farm first when it has one nearby. Never feeds pets, named, leashed or fenced animals that are not on its own farm. Keeps seeds for replanting.

animal.description: which kind; default the best one it has food for

radius.description: how far to look for animals

lure.description: lead them to its farm first (when one is within 64 blocks)

maxHerd.description: do not breed a kind with this many adults around

variant:companion.name: repair_farm
variant:companion.description: Look at one of its own farms that site health marked bad (flooded, frozen) and repair it where it is when that is a small job: break the frozen water in the middle and keep it open, fill flooded field cells with dirt, put the water back with a bucket. A farm that reads fine again goes back on its list. When the repair is too big (settings farming.badFarm, repairMaxBlocks, repairTries) it leaves the farm for a new one elsewhere, or for the owners. (Long-running: starts in the background and keeps going until stopped or replaced.)

farm.description: which bad farm (farm:1...); default the nearest to home

spawnClearance.description: never dig within this distance of the world spawn

variant:companion.name: plot_farm
variant:companion.description: Turn the farm plot its base keeps free inside the walls (base project farm_plot) into a small farm, no bucket needed: water already in reach of the plot, or ice it carries (only Silk Touch brings ice) broken in the middle, else a dry plot (crops on dry farmland still grow, about half as fast, as long as every tilled cell is planted). Torches give the crops light 9 and keep the middle water from freezing. Settings farming.plot, plotWater (auto | water | dry), plotSwap. (Long-running: starts in the background and keeps going until stopped or replaced.)

spawnClearance.description: never till within this distance of the world spawn

variant:companion.name: fish
variant:companion.description: Fish for food: takes a rod from its chests or makes one from 2 string and 3 sticks (taking what it lacks from its chests) when it has none, goes to open water near home (or breaks a hole in a frozen lake, which turns back into water over the lake), and fishes until it has `count` catches or `maxMinutes` pass. Cod and salmon are cooked later by keep_fed. (Long-running: starts in the background and keeps going until stopped or replaced.)

count.description: catches to stop at

radius.description: how far from home to look for water

variant:companion.name: food_sources
variant:companion.description: Say which food source it relies on for the long run (a farm, the base plot, a bad farm to repair, animals, fishing, foraging), in the order settings food.sources gives, and why each one before it was skipped.

variant:companion.name: find_target
variant:companion.description: Find something and report where it is: blocks and families (iron, diamonds, coal, logs, sand, water, lava), mobs (sheep, cows, villager), structures (village, nether portal, chest), biomes (desert, snow, ocean) or modded names. Looks at what is loaded around it, then remembered spots, then scouts a spiral on the surface by day (and can strip mine for ores). Remembers the spot as a place (found:iron for iron), reports coordinates, distance and direction from you, and comes back (or stays there with go). With bring it also fetches count of it and hands them over. (Long-running: starts in the background and keeps going until stopped or replaced.)

target.description: what to look for, e.g. iron, sheep, water, village, desert

radius.description: how far to search, in blocks

bring.description: also fetch some of it (blocks and items only) and hand it over

count.description: how many to bring

go.description: walk there and stay, instead of coming back to report

prospect.description: ores: strip mine for it when none is in sight (always on with bring)

exposed.description: ores: only count ore with an open face (a cliff, a shallow cave) within mining.safeDepth of the surface, not ore buried in rock or deep in a cave

variant:companion.name: bring_item
variant:companion.description: Bring a player some of an item: from the inventory, from my own chests (ones I placed or listed in settings.storage.chests, never anyone else's), by crafting it (simple recipes), by gathering it (chop, mine, harvest village or own farms), or by finding its source first. Then walks to the player, follows them if they move, tosses it to them and says how many they really got. (Long-running: starts in the background and keeps going until stopped or replaced.)

item.description: item name, e.g. oak_planks, bread, raw_iron, cobblestone

count.description: how many

player.description: who to give it to; default whoever asked

max_minutes.description: time for a search when it has to look for the source

variant:companion.name: fetch_drops
variant:companion.description: Go to where a player (default: whoever asked) died and bring their dropped items back, if the bot can get there before they despawn (5 minutes). Uses the death message and where it last saw them, or coordinates you give. (Long-running: starts in the background and keeps going until stopped or replaced.)

x.description: where they died (with y and z), if the bot did not see it

try_anyway.description: go even when the items have probably despawned (they only age while the area is loaded)

variant:companion.name: chop_tree
variant:companion.description: Fell the nearest natural tree (any wood type): cut the logs, climbing the trunk on a pillar for the ones out of reach from the ground (and taking the pillar down again), pick up the drops and plant a sapling. With rings it widens the search (remembered tree spots, then ring by ring, with a trip out and back) instead of giving up. Crafts a wooden axe first if there is none and the inventory has the wood. Needs digging enabled. For "get N planks/logs" or materials for a build, prefer gather_materials, which chops as many trees as needed.

radius.description: how far to look for a tree, in blocks

replant.description: plant a sapling of the same kind afterwards if the bot has one

make_axe.description: craft a wooden axe first when there is none and there is wood for it

rings.description: look further out when there is no tree close: remembered tree spots first, then these rings (e.g. [32, 64, 128, 250]); rings past 64 are a scouting trip out and back, by day

avoid_spawn.description: leave trees within this many blocks of the world spawn alone (0 = no limit)

variant:companion.name: place_block
variant:companion.description: Place a block from the inventory at x y z. Needs a solid block next to that spot to build against.

item.description: block item to place, e.g. cobblestone

variant:companion.name: break_block
variant:companion.description: Break (mine) the block at x y z with the best tool in the inventory (crafts a pickaxe first for stone and ores when it can). Needs digging enabled. Refuses chests and other containers unless force=true.

variant:companion.name: build
variant:companion.description: Build a whole structure from a blueprint. For "build a house" use small_house (cozy 5x5 wooden house: log corners, pitched stair roof, windows, door, torches, crafting table, chest, bed if there is wool). Others: cottage (bigger 7x7 house on a cobblestone foundation with porch, glass windows, furnace), cabin (log cabin), watchtower (ladder, fenced platform), fortress (15x15 walled compound to put a house in), hut (plain box, quick), shelter (emergency 3x3 box around the bot), wall_segment, platform, tower. Picks a flat, clear spot near whoever asked (never in protected areas or over player builds), fills small dips, digs bumps and plants, faces the door to the player (or an open side), places blocks with the right facing (stairs, slabs, logs, doors, torches...), checks every block afterwards and fixes mistakes, and skips blocks that are already right, so calling it again resumes an interrupted build. gather=true first gathers what is missing. profile:pax.name: reply
profile:pax.description: Answer whoever triggered this turn, the way they talked to you (whisper or public chat).

text.description: what to say; keep it short, it is Minecraft chat

profile:pax.name: say
profile:pax.description: Say something in public chat.

text.description: what to say; keep it short, it is Minecraft chat

profile:pax.name: whisper
profile:pax.description: Whisper a private message to one player.

text.description: what to say; keep it short, it is Minecraft chat

profile:pax.name: recent_chat
profile:pax.description: Recent chat lines and events (oldest first).

profile:pax.name: remember
profile:pax.description: Save a long-term note (facts about players, places, promises). Survives restarts.

about.description: player or topic the note is about

profile:pax.name: recall
profile:pax.description: Search long-term notes. Without a query returns the latest ones.

profile:pax.name: pos
profile:pax.description: Report the bot's position.

profile:pax.name: hp
profile:pax.description: Report health, food and what the bot is doing.

profile:pax.name: stop
profile:pax.description: Stop whatever the bot is doing. Also the PvP kill switch: ends every fight with a player and every hunt, and an attacking PvP mode (revenge, targets, all) goes off.

profile:pax.name: config_list
profile:pax.description: List the settings that can be changed in game (feature toggles) with their current values.

profile:pax.name: config_get
profile:pax.description: Show one setting, what it does and whether it was changed in game.

profile:pax.name: config_set
profile:pax.description: Change a setting live (owners only), e.g. config_set llm.listen all, config_set reflexes.retreatBelow 6. Persists until config_reset.

profile:pax.name: config_reset
profile:pax.description: Undo in-game setting changes: one key, or all of them, back to the profile values (owners only).

profile:pax.name: come
profile:pax.description: Walk to a player (default: whoever asked).

player.description: player name; defaults to the requesting player

profile:pax.name: follow
profile:pax.description: Follow a player, staying close, until stopped. (Long-running: starts in the background and keeps going until stopped or replaced.)

player.description: player name; defaults to the requesting player

distance.description: how close to stay, in blocks

profile:pax.name: goto
profile:pax.description: Walk to block coordinates, any distance (long trips go in legs and can take minutes; it keeps going in the background until it arrives, gets stuck or is stopped). Omit y to go to the surface at x/z. (Long-running: starts in the background and keeps going until stopped or replaced.)

profile:pax.name: goto_player
profile:pax.description: Walk to where a player currently is (one-off, does not keep following).

profile:pax.name: look_at
profile:pax.description: Turn to look at a player.

profile:pax.name: jump
profile:pax.description: Jump once.

profile:pax.name: attack
profile:pax.description: Fight the most dangerous hostile mob nearby, or a specific entity by id. Never attacks players, villagers, golems, pets or named mobs.

entityId.description: entity id; default the most dangerous hostile mob nearby

radius.description: how far to look for a target, in blocks

profile:pax.name: guard
profile:pax.description: Stay near a player and kill hostile mobs that come close to them, until stopped. (Long-running: starts in the background and keeps going until stopped or replaced.)

player.description: player to protect; defaults to the requesting player

profile:pax.name: hunt
profile:pax.description: Hunt passive animals (cow, pig, sheep, chicken, rabbit, mooshroom) for food and pick up the drops. Never touches pets, named, tamed or leashed animals, babies, villagers or players, and by default leaves fenced animals alone.

animal.description: which animal; default the nearest huntable one

count.description: how many to kill

radius.description: how far to look, in blocks

pens.description: also hunt animals inside fences (only your own farm)

keepAtLeast.description: leave at least this many adults of each kind alive (sustainable herd)

reach.description: when an animal is out of reach on foot, bridge, pillar (up to 16 blocks of dirt, cobblestone or planks) or dig to it, never in protected areas or danger zones

profile:pax.name: gear_up
profile:pax.description: Put on the best armour in the inventory and put a totem of undying or a shield in the offhand.

danger.description: a fall or fire that could kill: the totem goes in the offhand whatever the health

profile:pax.name: pvp
profile:pax.description: PvP mode (owners only; anyone may turn it off or lower it): off (never fight players; also ends every fight and hunt) | defend (only fight back) | revenge (also go after whoever killed or attacked us) | targets (attack players on the target list) | all (attack every player in range except owners and friends). No mode: show the mode, targets and grudges.

profile:pax.name: attack_player
profile:pax.description: Put a player on the PvP target list (owners only): attacked on sight from now on (switches PvP to targets mode if needed). Never owners or friends.

profile:pax.name: spare_player
profile:pax.description: Take a player off the PvP target list and forgive any grudge against them, ending a fight or hunt with them.

profile:pax.name: hunt_player
profile:pax.description: Hunt a player down (owners only): put them on the target list, go where they were last seen and fight them. Gives up after combat.huntMinutes; "stop" or "pvp off" ends it. (Long-running: starts in the background and keeps going until stopped or replaced.)

profile:pax.name: pvp_list
profile:pax.description: Show the PvP mode, the target list, grudges (revenge: who, why, minutes left) and hunts.

profile:pax.name: eat
profile:pax.description: Eat the best food in the inventory, or the named item (e.g. rotten_flesh as a last resort when starving).

item.description: eat this item instead of the best food (rotten_flesh, spider_eye and the like only this way)

profile:pax.name: sleep
profile:pax.description: Sleep in a bed within 16 blocks (only works at night or during storms).

profile:pax.name: wake
profile:pax.description: Get out of bed.

profile:pax.name: pillar
profile:pax.description: Emergency escape: jump and place blocks underneath to stand on a pillar out of reach of mobs. Uses dirt/cobblestone/planks from the inventory.

item.description: block to use; default the most plentiful dirt/cobblestone/planks

profile:pax.name: climb_out
profile:pax.description: Get out of a pit, shaft or cave straight up to open sky: dig the block above if needed, jump and place a block underneath, repeat. Without blocks it carves stair steps up into the wall instead.

maxBlocks.description: give up after rising this many blocks

profile:pax.name: bunker
profile:pax.description: Hide from phantoms and other mobs: dig straight down 3 blocks, seal the hole above with a dug block, wait until morning (or until no hostiles are near), then climb out. Needs digging; not in protected areas. (Long-running: starts in the background and keeps going until stopped or replaced.)

maxMinutes.description: give up waiting after this long

untilDay.description: stay until morning instead of until mobs leave

profile:pax.name: inventory
profile:pax.description: List what the bot is carrying.

profile:pax.name: drop
profile:pax.description: Throw items towards the requesting player (or on the ground). item="all" drops everything.

item.description: item name, or "all"

count.description: how many; default the whole stack(s)

profile:pax.name: equip
profile:pax.description: Hold an item in the main hand.

profile:pax.name: collect
profile:pax.description: Mine a number of blocks of one type nearby and pick up the drops, with the right tool (crafts a pickaxe first for stone and ores when it can). Skips protected areas (spawn): if everything nearby is protected it walks out of the zone first. Needs digging enabled.

block.description: block name, e.g. oak_log, dirt, stone, cobblestone

profile:pax.name: recall_events
profile:pax.description: What happened: recent journal events (deaths, damage, kills, items, chat, actions, players, places...). Filter by type, time, place, player or text.

type.description: event types, comma separated: death, respawn, damage, kill, item_gained, item_lost, block_broken, block_placed, chat_in, chat_out, whisper, action, goal, player_seen, player_joined, player_left, place_visited, advancement, protected_area, food_spot, farm_started, found, connect, disconnect, llm_turn, container_changed, container_gone, help, site; or deaths, chat, items, blocks, players, actions, places, combat, llm, connections, food, finds, stuck, sites, chests, containers, storage

since.description: how far back: 30m, 1h, 2d, today, yesterday, a date (YYYY-MM-DD); default 24h

near.description: only events near "x y z" or "x z", optionally with a radius as 4th number (default 32)

text.description: only events whose details contain this text

fleet.description: include the other bots on this server

profile:pax.name: last_death
profile:pax.description: Where and when the bot last died, what killed it, what it lost, and whether the drops may still be there.

profile:pax.name: history
profile:pax.description: Summary of a period from the journal rollups: online time, deaths, actions and failures, items, places, players. Period: today, yesterday, a date, 3h, or an hour range like 10-12.

profile:pax.name: goto_death
profile:pax.description: Walk back to where the bot last died to pick up its dropped items (they despawn 5 minutes after death). (Long-running: starts in the background and keeps going until stopped or replaced.)

profile:pax.name: protect
profile:pax.description: Stay with a player as a bodyguard until stopped: keep close (between them and the nearest danger), kill mobs that threaten them (creepers near them first, archers with a shot at them, diving phantoms, mobs coming for them or that hurt them), block arrows with a shield, and toss them food when they look hurt. Never attacks players, pets, villagers, golems or named mobs; neutral mobs only when they attack. (Long-running: starts in the background and keeps going until stopped or replaced.)

player.description: player to protect; defaults to the requesting player

feed.description: toss food when their health is low (needs the server to send player health)

keepFood.description: food items to keep for itself

intercept.description: meet a mob walking at the player 6-12 blocks out on its path instead of at the player

pullAggro.description: with two or more mobs on the player, hit each once and step off so they follow the bot

profile:pax.name: feed_player
profile:pax.description: Walk up to a player and toss them food from the inventory (the best food, 1-2 items), keeping some for itself.

player.description: who to feed; defaults to the requesting player

keepFood.description: food items to keep for itself

profile:pax.name: wander
profile:pax.description: Take a short walk to a random spot within a radius of home (or of a given center, or of where the bot stands).

radius.description: how far from the center to wander, in blocks

x.description: center x; default home, else current position

profile:pax.name: set_home
profile:pax.description: Remember a home position (default: where the bot stands now).

profile:pax.name: go_home
profile:pax.description: Walk back to the remembered home position.

range.description: how close to get, in blocks

profile:pax.name: remember_place
profile:pax.description: Remember a named place (default: where the bot stands now), to walk back to later with goto_place.

profile:pax.name: forget_place
profile:pax.description: Forget a named place.

profile:pax.name: places
profile:pax.description: List home and remembered places.

profile:pax.name: goto_place
profile:pax.description: Walk to a place remembered with remember_place.

profile:pax.name: flee
profile:pax.description: Run away from the nearest hostile mob until it is a safe distance away.

distance.description: how far to get from the mob

entityId.description: run from this mob instead of the nearest hostile one

profile:pax.name: prepare_trip
profile:pax.description: Get ready to leave home: take food from my pantry and own chests up to trips.food items, hold my best weapon, and check health. Fails with what is missing (no weapon, too little food, low health) when I should not go; a food trip while starving goes anyway.

purpose.description: what the trip is for, for the report

kind.description: food trips may go while starving; the others need the kit

distance.description: planned distance from home, in blocks

waive.description: checks to skip for this trip

profile:pax.name: craft
profile:pax.description: Craft an item from what is in the inventory. Uses a crafting table within 16 blocks when the recipe needs one, or puts one down (from the inventory, or made from planks).

item.description: item to make, e.g. stick, crafting_table, stone_pickaxe

count.description: how many items to end up with (not recipe runs)

profile:pax.name: smelt
profile:pax.description: Smelt items in a furnace within 32 blocks (or one placed from the inventory), add fuel, wait and take the results.

item.description: item to smelt, e.g. raw_iron, sand, oak_log

fuel.description: fuel item; default the best one in the inventory (coal, charcoal, planks, logs...)

profile:pax.name: deposit
profile:pax.description: Put items into the nearest chest/barrel (or the one at x y z). item="all" stores everything except tools, armour, food and anything in keep; `items` stores exactly those counts. Without x y z it never picks the pantry (settings.storage.chests role pantry) for anything but food.

item.description: item name, or "all"

count.description: how many; default all of them

items.description: exact items and counts to store, e.g. {"snowball": 16}; overrides item and count

x.description: container x; omit all three to use the nearest chest/barrel

profile:pax.name: withdraw
profile:pax.description: Take items out of the nearest chest/barrel (or the one at x y z).

item.description: item name, or "all" to empty the container

count.description: how many; default all of that item

x.description: container x; omit all three to use the nearest chest/barrel

profile:pax.name: list_container
profile:pax.description: Say what is inside the nearest chest/barrel (or the one at x y z). Looks inside if it is within reach and the bot is idle, otherwise reports what it saw last time.

x.description: container x; omit all three to use the nearest chest/barrel

profile:pax.name: check_chests
profile:pax.description: Look inside its own chests (ones it placed) and the configured ones (settings.storage.chests) near home that it has not looked into lately, so what it remembers is right again: notes items taken or added, chests moved or broken, and says when the pantry runs low. Never opens anyone else's chest.

radius.description: chests within this many blocks of home

max.description: chests to look into this time

all.description: also chests it looked into lately

x.description: look into just this one of its chests (with y and z)

profile:pax.name: where_stored
profile:pax.description: Say where an item is stored, from what the bot remembers seeing in chests and barrels: position and how long ago it looked ("12 iron_ingot in the chest at 559 69 -47, seen 2 h ago"). Older sightings are marked as maybe changed. bring_item fetches it from its own chests.

item.description: item name or a word of it, e.g. iron, bread, oak_log

profile:pax.name: place_chest
profile:pax.description: Put down a new chest of its own near home (crafted from 8 planks when it has none): a free spot outside within `range` blocks of home, off paths and farmland, not beside a door, another chest, the farm, or in a protected area; inside (the owner's room) only when nothing outside works. Remembers it as its own storage chest.

range.description: how far from home to look for a spot

profile:pax.name: harvest
profile:pax.description: Harvest ripe wheat, carrots, potatoes and beetroot nearby (or within a radius of x y z, e.g. one field), pick up the drops and replant from the inventory.

radius.description: how far to look for crops, in blocks

x.description: centre of the field (with y and z); default where the bot stands

profile:pax.name: plant
profile:pax.description: Plant seeds (wheat_seeds, carrot, potato, beetroot_seeds) on empty farmland nearby.

seed.description: seed item; default whatever seeds the bot has

count.description: how many to plant at most

x.description: centre of the field (with y and z); default where the bot stands

profile:pax.name: till
profile:pax.description: Turn dirt or grass into farmland with a hoe, either at x y z or the nearest spots next to water. Needs digging enabled.

x.description: block to till; omit x/y/z to pick dirt near water

profile:pax.name: find_food
profile:pax.description: Scout for food beyond what is in sight: first known food spots, then an expanding spiral around home (or here) out to `radius` blocks, by day, avoiding water, lava and protected areas, until it sees huntable animals or a village farm. Remembers what it finds as places (food:animals, food:village_farm, food:water). Does not hunt; use hunt or keep_fed after. (Long-running: starts in the background and keeps going until stopped or replaced.)

radius.description: how far from home to scout, in blocks

crops.description: village farms (crops with villagers nearby) count as food too

keepAtLeast.description: only count animals above this many adults of a kind (a herd to spare)

from.description: centre of the search: home (when set) or where the bot stands

minRadius.description: skip rings at or inside this radius (an earlier, smaller search covered them)

seeds.description: pick up this many seeds on the way by breaking grass next to the path (for a farm later)

profile:pax.name: start_farm
profile:pax.description: Start a small farm of its own: picks grass or dirt by water near home (or a place), outside protected areas and away from anybody's builds or fields (or pours water from a bucket), then gets seeds by breaking grass (or uses carrots, potatoes, beetroot seeds), makes a hoe if needed, tills a plot around the water, plants it, fences and lights it if it has the materials, and remembers it as farm:1, farm:2... for farm_loop/farm_setup. Needs digging enabled. (Long-running: starts in the background and keeps going until stopped or replaced.)

place.description: remembered place (or home) to farm near; default home, else here

x.description: farm near this x (with z) instead

size.description: plot side, odd, around one water block (9 = 80 farmland)

radius.description: how far from the centre to look for water

seeds.description: seeds to collect before planting (breaks grass until it has them or gives up)

fence.description: fence the plot when it has (or can craft) enough fences

light.description: put torches on the corners when it has torches or coal

spawnClearance.description: never farm within this distance of the world spawn

profile:pax.name: tend_farm
profile:pax.description: Look after its own farm (farm:1, farm:2...): put the water back if it is gone (with a bucket), plant bare farmland, till trampled dirt again and plant it, and grow the plot a ring at a time towards `size` around its water with the seeds it has, keeping `seedReserve` seeds for replanting; short of seeds it takes them from its own and configured chests near home first. Use harvest for ripe crops. Needs digging enabled for tilling. (Long-running: starts in the background and keeps going until stopped or replaced.)

size.description: side of the square to grow the farm towards (one water block keeps 9x9 wet)

seedReserve.description: seeds kept for replanting: new cells only from seeds beyond these

maxCells.description: cells to plant or till at most this run

fromChests.description: short of seeds: take them from its own and configured chests near home first

spawnClearance.description: never till within this distance of the world spawn

profile:pax.name: gather_seeds
profile:pax.description: Get seeds for a farm by breaking surface grass and ferns nearby (open to the sky and near its own height, never cave grass; wheat seeds drop about 1 in 8) and picking them up. Keeps going, patch by patch out to the radius, until it has the seeds, the time is up or the grass runs out. Skips protected areas and the world spawn. First takes wheat seeds from its own and configured chests near home (fromChests). Needs digging enabled for the grass. (Long-running: starts in the background and keeps going until stopped or replaced.)

count.description: seeds to get

fromChests.description: take seeds from its own and configured chests near home before breaking grass

radius.description: how far to look for grass

spawnClearance.description: never break grass this close to the world spawn

profile:pax.name: forage
profile:pax.description: Stopgap food from what grows wild nearby: pick ripe sweet berries (the bush stays), cut kelp at the shore without diving (smelt it into dried kelp later), and with apples=true break oak and dark oak leaves for apples (about 1 in 200) and pick up apples lying around. Never on protected land. (Long-running: starts in the background and keeps going until stopped or replaced.)

radius.description: how far to look

max.description: bushes or kelp stalks to take at most

apples.description: also break leaves for apples (slow, low odds: a last resort)

leaves.description: leaves to break at most for apples

profile:pax.name: breed
profile:pax.description: Breed two adult animals of a kind it sees (cows/sheep with wheat, pigs with carrots/potatoes/beetroot, chickens with seeds), leading them towards its farm first when it has one nearby. Never feeds pets, named, leashed or fenced animals that are not on its own farm. Keeps seeds for replanting.

animal.description: which kind; default the best one it has food for

radius.description: how far to look for animals

lure.description: lead them to its farm first (when one is within 64 blocks)

maxHerd.description: do not breed a kind with this many adults around

profile:pax.name: repair_farm
profile:pax.description: Look at one of its own farms that site health marked bad (flooded, frozen) and repair it where it is when that is a small job: break the frozen water in the middle and keep it open, fill flooded field cells with dirt, put the water back with a bucket. A farm that reads fine again goes back on its list. When the repair is too big (settings farming.badFarm, repairMaxBlocks, repairTries) it leaves the farm for a new one elsewhere, or for the owners. (Long-running: starts in the background and keeps going until stopped or replaced.)

farm.description: which bad farm (farm:1...); default the nearest to home

spawnClearance.description: never dig within this distance of the world spawn

profile:pax.name: plot_farm
profile:pax.description: Turn the farm plot its base keeps free inside the walls (base project farm_plot) into a small farm, no bucket needed: water already in reach of the plot, or ice it carries (only Silk Touch brings ice) broken in the middle, else a dry plot (crops on dry farmland still grow, about half as fast, as long as every tilled cell is planted). Torches give the crops light 9 and keep the middle water from freezing. Settings farming.plot, plotWater (auto | water | dry), plotSwap. (Long-running: starts in the background and keeps going until stopped or replaced.)

spawnClearance.description: never till within this distance of the world spawn

profile:pax.name: fish
profile:pax.description: Fish for food: takes a rod from its chests or makes one from 2 string and 3 sticks (taking what it lacks from its chests) when it has none, goes to open water near home (or breaks a hole in a frozen lake, which turns back into water over the lake), and fishes until it has `count` catches or `maxMinutes` pass. Cod and salmon are cooked later by keep_fed. (Long-running: starts in the background and keeps going until stopped or replaced.)

count.description: catches to stop at

radius.description: how far from home to look for water

profile:pax.name: food_sources
profile:pax.description: Say which food source it relies on for the long run (a farm, the base plot, a bad farm to repair, animals, fishing, foraging), in the order settings food.sources gives, and why each one before it was skipped.

profile:pax.name: find_target
profile:pax.description: Find something and report where it is: blocks and families (iron, diamonds, coal, logs, sand, water, lava), mobs (sheep, cows, villager), structures (village, nether portal, chest), biomes (desert, snow, ocean) or modded names. Looks at what is loaded around it, then remembered spots, then scouts a spiral on the surface by day (and can strip mine for ores). Remembers the spot as a place (found:iron for iron), reports coordinates, distance and direction from you, and comes back (or stays there with go). With bring it also fetches count of it and hands them over. (Long-running: starts in the background and keeps going until stopped or replaced.)

target.description: what to look for, e.g. iron, sheep, water, village, desert

radius.description: how far to search, in blocks

bring.description: also fetch some of it (blocks and items only) and hand it over

count.description: how many to bring

go.description: walk there and stay, instead of coming back to report

prospect.description: ores: strip mine for it when none is in sight (always on with bring)

exposed.description: ores: only count ore with an open face (a cliff, a shallow cave) within mining.safeDepth of the surface, not ore buried in rock or deep in a cave

profile:pax.name: bring_item
profile:pax.description: Bring a player some of an item: from the inventory, from my own chests (ones I placed or listed in settings.storage.chests, never anyone else's), by crafting it (simple recipes), by gathering it (chop, mine, harvest village or own farms), or by finding its source first. Then walks to the player, follows them if they move, tosses it to them and says how many they really got. (Long-running: starts in the background and keeps going until stopped or replaced.)

item.description: item name, e.g. oak_planks, bread, raw_iron, cobblestone

count.description: how many

player.description: who to give it to; default whoever asked

max_minutes.description: time for a search when it has to look for the source

profile:pax.name: fetch_drops
profile:pax.description: Go to where a player (default: whoever asked) died and bring their dropped items back, if the bot can get there before they despawn (5 minutes). Uses the death message and where it last saw them, or coordinates you give. (Long-running: starts in the background and keeps going until stopped or replaced.)

x.description: where they died (with y and z), if the bot did not see it

try_anyway.description: go even when the items have probably despawned (they only age while the area is loaded)

profile:pax.name: chop_tree
profile:pax.description: Fell the nearest natural tree (any wood type): cut the logs, climbing the trunk on a pillar for the ones out of reach from the ground (and taking the pillar down again), pick up the drops and plant a sapling. With rings it widens the search (remembered tree spots, then ring by ring, with a trip out and back) instead of giving up. Crafts a wooden axe first if there is none and the inventory has the wood. Needs digging enabled. For "get N planks/logs" or materials for a build, prefer gather_materials, which chops as many trees as needed.

radius.description: how far to look for a tree, in blocks

replant.description: plant a sapling of the same kind afterwards if the bot has one

make_axe.description: craft a wooden axe first when there is none and there is wood for it

rings.description: look further out when there is no tree close: remembered tree spots first, then these rings (e.g. [32, 64, 128, 250]); rings past 64 are a scouting trip out and back, by day

avoid_spawn.description: leave trees within this many blocks of the world spawn alone (0 = no limit)

profile:pax.name: place_block
profile:pax.description: Place a block from the inventory at x y z. Needs a solid block next to that spot to build against.

item.description: block item to place, e.g. cobblestone

profile:pax.name: break_block
profile:pax.description: Break (mine) the block at x y z with the best tool in the inventory (crafts a pickaxe first for stone and ores when it can). Needs digging enabled. Refuses chests and other containers unless force=true.

profile:pax.name: build
profile:pax.description: Build a whole structure from a blueprint. For "build a house" use small_house (cozy 5x5 wooden house: log corners, pitched stair roof, windows, door, torches, crafting table, chest, bed if there is wool). Others: cottage (bigger 7x7 house on a cobblestone foundation with porch, glass windows, furnace), cabin (log cabin), watchtower (ladder, fenced platform), fortress (15x15 walled compound to put a house in), hut (plain box, quick), shelter (emergency 3x3 box around the bot), wall_segment, platform, tower. Picks a flat, clear spot near whoever asked (never in protected areas or over player builds), fills small dips, digs bumps and plants, faces the door to the player (or an open side), places blocks with the right facing (stairs, slabs, logs, doors, torches...), checks every block afterwards and fixes mistakes, and skips blocks that are already right, so calling it again resumes an interrupted build. gather=true first gathers what is missing.
